svg.text: SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE FLOWCHART — JOBHUNT (DUAL-APP EMPLOYER CMS & JOB SEEKER PORTAL)
Stack: Next.js App Router (2 Apps) | TypeScript 5 | Prisma ORM v5.2 | PostgreSQL | Supabase Storage | NextAuth.js | SWR & Zod
• Tab 1 (Overview): Logo upload, industry, techStack[], bio
• Tab 2 (Social Links): Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter, YouTube
• Tab 3 (Teams): Add & showcase core company team members
• CKEditor 5 Rich HTML: Description, Responsibility, WhoYouAre
• Dynamic requiredSkills[] & JSON Benefits builder + Quota
• Applicant Inspector: View portfolio, LinkedIn & PDF Resume
• Multi-Checkbox Dynamic Filter by CategoryJob & Industry
• Company Directory: Tech stack badges, teams & active openings
• Visual Progress Bar comparing Job.applicants vs Job.needs
• FormModalApply: React Hook Form + Zod schema validation
• Direct client upload of PDF CV to Supabase 'applicant' bucket
02. NEXT.JS ROUTE HANDLERS, NEXTAUTH & ZOD LAYER
• CredentialsProvider with stateless JWT Session strategy
• CMS Auth authenticates against Prisma model: Company
• Website Auth authenticates against Prisma model: User
• Passwords hashed via bcryptjs before Prisma create
Upserts social links & inserts CompanyTeam members
Creates Job posting with CKEditor HTML & JSON benefits
Fetches master Industry options for profile setup
Aggregates _count.Job per category & fetches top 6 jobs
Dynamic Prisma IN-clause query powered by client SWR hooks
1. Inserts candidate record + resume filename into Applicant
• CUID (@default(cuid())) primary keys & relational nested includes
Real-Time Sync: Jobs posted in CMS appear immediately on Public Website
• Opened by HR in CMS ATS
[1-2] App 1: Job Hunt CMS (Employer Dashboard, CKEditor 5, ATS) | [3-4] App 2: Job Hunt Website (SWR Filter, 1-Click Apply) | [5-7] NextAuth.js Dual JWT + Zod | [8-9] Prisma + Supabase Buckets
